clues.text: After a vision of a Macedonian man, Paul sailed via Neapolis to this Roman colony, a leading city of Macedonia.
On the Sabbath in this Macedonian city, Paul's group went outside the gate to a riverside place of prayer.
In this Macedonian city, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira listened as the Lord opened her heart.
After she and her household were baptized here, Lydia persuaded Paul and his companions to stay at her house.
After the Feast of Unleavened Bread, Paul's group sailed from this city and reached Troas five days later.
Paul and Timothy wrote to the saints in this Macedonian city, along with its overseers and deacons.
Paul told the Thessalonians he had suffered shameful treatment in this city before preaching to them.
